# Credits {.unnumbered}

The chapter list was constructed by surveying publicly
available guidance on AI-assisted research workflows,
including documentation for large language model tools used
in literature review, coding, writing, and reproducibility,
and adopting the topics common to the majority of them.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the R script at
`images/build-cover.R`. Watercolor palette: deep violet
through amethyst to pale mist, anchored on a brand violet
`#6a4c93`. Typography: Avenir family (Apple system font);
body text in Source Serif 4.

The three ambiance photographs in each day chapter (an opening
image, a mid-lecture image, and a worked-example image) are
AI-generated; see the Colophon for the disclosure and
`images/README.md` for every image's full generation prompt.

The epigraphs opening each day chapter are drawn from published
primary sources (an academic paper, a proverb, a technical
report, a memoir on writing, and a commencement address), cited
in full in the References; none was written or paraphrased by
an AI tool, in keeping with this book's own subject matter.
